text:
Priya S: Heads-up  I'm updating the Greeter quickstart to fix auth + docker env oddities. PR ready but want a quick sanity check for Windows + docker-compose.
Alex P: happy to run it on my Win laptop later today. Which oddities?
Priya S: env var names inconsistent (API_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY), compose doesn't show how to override the service port, and README only shows bash exports.
Dan M: simple fix add canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, show .env usage, and compose with substitution e.g. 
```yaml
ports:
  - "${GREETER_PORT:-3000}:3000"
```
Alex P: also add a PowerShell line: `$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"; npm run start` so Windows folks can follow.
Marie L: +1. Please avoid recommending setx since that persists. Mention dotenv for local dev.
Priya S: good call. I'll normalize vars and add a small note about token scopes (read-only for embeddings vs full for chat).
ci-bot: PR #4182 triggered CI  status: running smoke tests
Alex P: I'll push a tiny commit with the PowerShell snippet and compose port fix. After CI, can we merge EOD?
Priya S: yep, target EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
